topic: Patterns of Inheritance: Dominant and Recessive Traits
key_concepts: Genes are segments of DNA that serve as the fundamental units of heredity
Alleles are different versions of a gene found at the same locus on homologous chromosomes
Dominant traits are expressed when present and override recessive alleles
Recessive traits are expressed only in the absence of the dominant allele
